question: How must the genitive be read for the making-force to stand firm?
premises: genitive read in the agent sense leaves an irremovable defect
read in the object sense instead
then the making-force stands firm at heart
inference: The karma-reading saves the construction; the making-force holds.
uncertainties: kartari/karmani sasthi is Paninian genitive-role doctrine; nyartha kept non-technical per gate
plain_english: If the sixth is stated in the agent sense, the defect is hard to remove; now, this sixth in the object sense — the making-force stands firm at heart.
